import hashlib,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd(); p=root/'udt_response_measurement_scaling_2026-09-28'
launch=json.loads((p/'LAUNCH.json').read_text())
maintained={'LIVE.md','HANDOFF.md','CURRENT_RESEARCH_PROGRAM.md','MEMORY.md','INDEX.md','UDT_RESEARCH_ROADMAP.md'}
def git(*args): return subprocess.check_output(['git',*args],cwd=root)
def digest(raw): return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
def verify(pins,base=root,baseline=False):
 for name,expected in pins.items():
  raw=git('show',launch['head']+':'+name) if baseline and name in maintained else (base/name).read_bytes()
  assert digest(raw)==expected,name
 return len(pins)
assert git('branch','--show-current').decode().strip()=='grok'
assert git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip()==launch['head']
assert git('rev-parse','origin/grok').decode().strip()==launch['head']
assert set(git('diff','--name-only').decode().splitlines())==maintained
assert not git('diff','--cached','--name-only')
counts={'launch_sources':verify(launch['source_sha256'],baseline=True),
 'additional_sources':verify(json.loads((p/'ADDITIONAL_SOURCES.json').read_text())),
 'initial_candidate':verify(json.loads((p/'CANDIDATE_FREEZE.json').read_text())['files'],base=p)}
for name,key in [('SOURCE_FIRST_FREEZE.json','source_sha256'),('INDEPENDENT_CHECK_FREEZE.json','hashes'),('DIRECT_FREEZE.json','hashes')]:
 counts[name]=verify(json.loads((p/'review'/name).read_text())[key])
final=json.loads((p/'review/FINAL_FIDELITY.json').read_text())
counts['final_files']=verify(final['reviewed_file_sha256'])
counts['final_evidence']=verify(final['review_evidence_sha256'])
untracked=set(git('ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard','-z').decode().split('\0'))-{''}
outside={name for name in untracked if not name.startswith(p.name+'/')}
assert outside==set(launch['preexisting_untracked_paths'])
subprocess.run(['git','diff','--check'],check=True)
files=[f for f in p.rglob('*') if f.is_file() and '__pycache__' not in f.parts]
size=sum(f.stat().st_size for f in files); assert size<10_000_000
print(json.dumps({'status':'PASS','meaning':'source and packaging correspondence, not scientific proof',
 'pin_counts':counts,'preserved_untracked_pathnames':len(outside),'protected_payloads_read':False,
 'maintained_paths':sorted(maintained),'files_at_check':len(files),'bytes_at_check':size}))
